tooltip.mythblades.rainbow.1: Hits leave a random color effect (fire, weakness, glow, poison, slowness, blindness, levitation)
tooltip.mythblades.rainbow.2: Right-click: throw a rainbow crescent · In mid-air: cloud step
tooltip.mythblades.crimson.1: Every hit fills the veins with essence and steals life
tooltip.mythblades.crimson.2: Right-click: Crimson Lunge — dash into the targeted enemy, stronger with essence
tooltip.mythblades.mossroot.1: Hold and release: slam the ground, the shockwave launches enemies
tooltip.mythblades.mossroot.2: Right-click stone/dirt: grow moss · Chops trees fast
tooltip.mythblades.mossroot.3: Repairs itself in rain or on grass
